paragraphs.text: Rundvelt is a mountainous area in Aerona , occupied by goblins . It is located just south of Sursi , near the Olesian plains. There are over thirty human villages in the Rundvelt range, and the caves have been inhabited by goblins for centuries.

The Rundvelt goblins mastered the use of Rock Sleds and siege equipment and even developed a societal structure. The most famous Rundvelt goblin was Pashalik Mons , a leader around 4000 AR . In 4562 AR, Mons's descendant Rulik Mons would ally nine tribes into a single warband to join the Coalition .
